title: Ken watches you study with Aigis

cues.text: The dorm lounge. You sit at the dining table, studying with Aigis. Ken stands nearby, watching, with Koromaru sitting at his feet.
Ken has joined you and Aigis at the table with his workbooks, Koromaru at his side.
Some time later, Ken has nodded off over his workbook, his chin propped on his hand.
